result.summary: This pull request adds boundary test coverage in test/functional/p2p_leak.py and test/functional/p2p_sendtxrcncl.py for peers connecting with nVersion == 70016 (WTXID_RELAY_VERSION). It asserts that WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, and SENDTXRCNCL messages are delivered at this exact version boundary, killing mutation testing survivals.
result.problem: Existing functional tests checked that pre-wtxidrelay peers (nVersion 70015) do not receive WTXIDRELAY, SENDADDRV2, or SENDTXRCNCL, but no test asserted that peers at the lower boundary of 70016 receive them. A regression changing the comparison from >= to > would not be caught.

resolved_concerns: naiyoma suggested expanding the PR to also cover the SENDTXRCNCL version check at net_processing.cpp#3466, which the author incorporated via a second commit co-authored with naiyoma.
